Name: Jehiel, Ruler of the House of God
Role: Ruler of the House of God
Summary: Jehiel, a ruler of the house of God with Hilkiah and Zechariah, gave the priests two thousand six hundred small cattle and three hundred oxen for Josiah's Passover offerings.
KeyStory: Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, rulers of the house of God, gave unto the priests for the passover offerings.
RelatedPeople: Hilkiah, the High Priest; Zechariah, Ruler of the House of God; King Josiah
LifeLesson: Generous rulers made a Passover like none since Samuel possible.
